title: Erasing Concepts, Steering Generations: A Comprehensive Survey of Concept Suppression
reasoning: The paper is a survey of concept suppression techniques in text-to-image models. While it discusses the ethical and safety implications of uncontrolled image generation (such as nudity, bias, and violence) and aims to guide researchers toward more ethically aligned models, it does not include a component that benchmarks or evaluates religion, moral philosophy, or formal ethical frameworks.
